stem: 金融行动特别工作组（FATF）式区域机构（FSRBs）的作用在于：（选择三项。）

options.A: 通过发布源自其 FSRB 管辖区以外成员的金融犯罪类型学研究（犯罪模式），识别并应对当前的金融犯罪趋势。
options.B: 向其 FSRB 管辖区内成员提供所需的 AML/CFT 技术援助。
options.C: 协调为其 FSRB 管辖区内成员提供技术援助。
options.D: 为其 FSRB 管辖区内成员制定和修订金融行动特别工作组（FATF）的40项建议。
options.E: 识别并解决其 FSRB 管辖区以外成员在 AML/CFT 政策方面的任何漏洞。

stem_en: The role of FATF-style regional bodies (FSRBs) is to: (Select three.)

options_en.A: Identify and address the current financial crime trends through the issuance of typologies originating in members outside of their FSRB's jurisdiction.
options_en.B: Provide AML/CFT technical assistance needed by members in their FSRB jurisdiction.
options_en.C: Coordinate technical assistance for members in their FSRB jurisdiction.
options_en.D: Set and amend the FATF 40 Recommendations for members in their FSRB jurisdiction.
options_en.E: Identify and address any gaps in the AML/CFT policies for members outside of their FSRB jurisdiction.
